title: A "Plug-And-Display" Nanoparticle Vaccine Platform Based on Outer Membrane Vesicles Displaying SARS-CoV-2 Receptor-Binding Domain
protocol: Insert DNA encoding SpyCatcher sequence into an ampicillin-resistant pThioHisA-ClyA plasmid between the BamH I and Sal I sites.
Ligate the synthesized SpyTag-RBD-Histag fusion gene into a pcDNA3.1 plasmid between the BamH I and EcoR I sites.
Add 5 μL of pThioHisA ClyA-SC plasmid solution to 50 μL of BL21 competent strain, gently blow, and let cool on ice for 30 min.
Place the bacterial suspension in a water bath at 42 °C for 90 s, then put it immediately on ice for 3 min.
Add 500 μL of LB medium to the bacterial suspension and culture at 220 rpm at 37 °C for 1 h.
Plate all the transformation onto an LB agar plate containing ampicillin (100 µg/mL) and culture overnight at 37 °C.
Isolate a single colony from the plate and transfer it to 20 mL of LB (ampicillin-resistant) medium, then culture overnight at 220 rpm at 37 °C.
Inoculate the bacterial solution into 2 L medium.
Culture at 220 rpm, 37°C for 5 hours until logarithmic growth (OD600nm between 0.6 to 0.8).
Add IPTG to achieve a final concentration of 0.5 mM in the bacterial solution.
Continue culturing overnight at 220 rpm, 25°C.
Centrifuge the bacterial solution at 7,000 x g at 4°C for 30 minutes.
Filter the supernatant through a 0.22 µm membrane filter.
Concentrate the filtrate using a 100 kD ultrafiltration membrane or hollow fiber column.
Filter the concentrate through a 0.22 µm membrane filter.
Centrifuge the filtered concentrate at 150,000 x g at 4°C for 2 hours.
Discard the supernatant with a pipette.
Resuspend the precipitation in PBS.
Store the solution at -80°C.
Select an appropriate eukaryotic expression system (e.g., HEK293F).
Culture cells overnight at 130 rpm, 37°C after recovery.
Add 20 µL of HEK293F cell solution into the automated cell counter.
Record the number of cells.
Adjust the concentration to 1 x 10^6 cells/mL.
Culture adjusted cells at 130 rpm, 37°C for 4 hours.
Filter RBD-ST plasmid through a 0.22 μm membrane filter.
Add 300 µg of filtered plasmids into cell culture medium to make the final volume 10 mL; shake for 10 s.
Heat PEI (1 mg/mL) to 65 °C in a water bath, mix 0.7 mL of PEI with 9.3 mL of cell culture medium, and shake intermittently for 10 s.
Add plasmid solution to the PEI solution; shake the mixture intermittently for 10 s, and incubate at 37 °C for 15 min.
Add the mixture to 280 mL of cell culture medium and culture at 130 rpm at 37 °C for 5 days.
Centrifuge cells at 6,000 x g at 25 °C for 20 min; use a pipette to collect the supernatant.
Fill a column with 2 mL of Ni-NTA agarose and wash it 3 times with PBS.
Add imidazole into cell supernatant to make the final concentration 20 mM, then load the cell supernatant twice onto the column.
Wash the column with 3 column volumes of PBS containing 20 mM imidazole; collect the washing fraction.
Gradient elute the column with 3 column volumes of PBS containing increasing concentrations (e.g., 0.3 M, 0.4 M, 0.5 M) of imidazole; elute twice for each concentration.
Use SDS-PAGE to identify RBD-ST in different concentration gradients.
Determine protein concentration by the BCA method.
Serially dilute the standard BSA solution from 2 mg/mL to 0.0625 mg/mL.
Dilute purified OMV-SC and RBD-ST 10x in PBS.
Mix BCA working solutions A and B at a ratio of 50:1 (v/v).
Add diluted protein solution (25 µL/well) to the mixed BCA working solution.
Incubate the mixture at 37 °C for 30 min.
Measure absorbance (OD) at 562 nm of each well.
Calculate the protein concentration from the standard curve.
Mix OMV-SC and RBD-ST in PBS at a ratio of 40:1 (w/w).
Vertically rotate the mixture overnight at 15 rpm at 4 °C.
Prepare 10 µL of OMV-SC, RBD-ST, and reaction product.
Add 2.5 µL of 5x loading buffer to each sample.
Heat samples at 100 °C for 5 min.
Load the samples into the gel (10 µL/well).
Perform electrophoresis at 60 V for 20 min.
Change electrophoresis condition to 120 V and continue for 1 h.
Transfer protein from the gel to PVDF western blotting membranes at 100 V for 70 min.
Put the membrane into 5% non-fat powdered milk/TBST.
Shake the membrane in the solution for 1 hour.
Wash the membrane 3 times with TBST, each wash lasting 5 minutes.
Put the membrane into 0.1% His-Tag antibody/TBST.
Shake the membrane for 1 hour.
Wash the membrane 3 times with TBST for 5 minutes each with shaking.
Put the membrane into 0.02% anti-mouse IgG1 antibody (HRP)/TBST.
Shake the membrane for 40 minutes.
Wash the membrane 3 times with TBST for 5 minutes each with shaking.
Add enhanced chemiluminescence solution to the membrane.
Expose the membrane.
Dilute 1 mL of reacted OMV-RBD solution to 10 mL.
Centrifuge the dilution at 150,000 x g at 4 °C for 2 hours.
Discard the supernatant using a pipette.
Suspend the residue with 10 mL of PBS.
Centrifuge the suspension at 150,000 x g at 4 °C for 2 hours.
Discard the supernatant.
Suspend the residue with 1 mL of PBS.
Dilute the samples to a concentration of 100 µg/mL for DLS measurement.
Add 1 mL of sample into the sample cell.
Choose "Size" for "Measurement type".
Choose "Protein" for "Sample material".
Choose "Water" for "Dispersant".
Set the temperature to "25 °C".
Load samples and measure automatically.
Dilute the samples to a concentration of 100 µg/mL for TEM imaging.
Take a 200-mesh copper grid.
Add 20 µL of sample to the grid.
Allow the sample to absorb for 10 minutes.
Use filter paper to wick off the solution.
Add 20 µL of 3% uranyl acetate to the support film.
Stain for 30 s.
Wick off the uranyl acetate.
Dry the film naturally at room temperature for 1 h.
Load the samples to the TEM system.
Capture images at 80 kV.
